response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and leadership in mentoring and open-source contributions, but his experience lacks depth in C++ and large-scale cloud compute infrastructure, which are critical for this role. His background in distributed systems and DevOps-adjacent work is promising but not directly aligned with the core requirements.
strengths: Extensive experience in software design, architecture, and mentoring through workshops and open-source projects.
Diverse technical background with exposure to distributed systems, real-time data processing, and DevOps practices.
Proven leadership in technical communities and ability to drive projects to completion (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts).
concerns: Only limited recent experience with C++ (last noted in 2015), falling short of the 8-year requirement.
Lacks explicit experience in cloud compute platforms or production-level cloud architecture (e.g., AWS/GCP at scale).
Most roles emphasize full-stack development rather than the specialized infrastructure focus of this position.
